title: Emotion Voice Game
shareTitle: Emotion Voice Game — Bring Feelings to Life
description: Choose happy, proud, calm, or silly; hear Teddy model the feeling; then use your own voice to light up a cozy felt theater. Microphone analysis stays local and no audio is recorded.
learningGoals: Change volume, steadiness, and pitch movement to make vocal feeling audible
Connect facial, body, and vocal cues with happy, proud, calm, and silly expression
Build confidence performing one short spoken line
interactionModel: tap a feeling card, listen to Teddy model the line, tap the microphone, and perform the same words with expressive prosody
feedbackModel: any clearly heard performance succeeds; local acoustic features vary one to three voice sparks and the matching Teddy pose, with a tap-to-perform fallback when microphone access is unavailable

modes.title: Feelings Show
modes.skill: expressing one sentence with contrasting vocal feelings

credits: QLOBE Kids contributors; original cozy-felt art generated with GPT Image 2 and finalized locally; see ASSETS.md.
